label: Signup Form
description: The LEAD'S side of a signup: a page's signup block (a newsletter, a waitlist, a free trial) in a light browser window. The block rises in, the email TYPES into the field character by character, a cursor comes to the button and presses it, and the form turns into its success line with a green check. The 'someone signs up' beat of a lifecycle or automation film -- cut from it (or flood from the pressed button) to the flow that reacts. Every time takes a word anchor. Laid out on a 1440-wide design stage at the box's aspect, scaled to the box: give it the full frame or a large box.

headline.label: Headline; *word* in the accent colour, a newline breaks the line

eyebrow.label: Small uppercase line above the headline (e.g. 'NEWSLETTER')

success_text.label: The success line after the press

success.label: Turn into the success line after the press (default true)

cursor.label: A cursor comes in and presses the button (default true)

accent.label: Accent colour: the italic word, the focus ring, the button (default #393bf5)

still.label: The block is whole from the first frame (no rise-in)

press_at.label: Button press at (s or @word; default right after the typing)

success_at.label: Success line at (default 0.3 s after the press)
